set.n: Berlanquette's saloon hoard, Sand Bay shore near Fayette
set.pl: Shore of Sand Bay about 2 mi S of the Fayette townsite; saloon site not placed to a lot
pinev: Shore of Sand Bay, 2 mi S of Fayette per the 1930 telling ('on the beach 2 mi from Fayette'); placed on land on the bay shore from 2015 Michigan lidar; saloon site not placed to a lot.
set.tovw: Lead grade C (treasure thread): 1930 Escanaba Daily Press plus a 1953 history and Neb's clipping; site only to the shore
set.warn: State park or private shore: look only.
